# Attribution — external field recordings

Audio in `audio/` was downloaded from the pages below. Every recording is either CC0 1.0 (Freesound) or public domain (radio aporee ::: maps), so attribution is not legally required. It is given as a courtesy. The clip list comes from hermes-aircraft-doppler-geolocation `docs/evaluation.md` ("Recordings and attribution"); CC BY entries there (klankbeeld 703104, curious_world_on_youtube 823581) and all YouTube items were deliberately not downloaded.

Freesound files are the public HQ preview MP3s (`cdn.freesound.org/previews/...-hq.mp3`), not the originals, because original downloads require login. Aporee files are the site's own download (`download.php?id=`).
